title: tracker start, shelve, reopen, reject and status --json
description: A move between states (DESIGN.md §2.2). The item's last history entry is the move just made. reject runs only from an interactive terminal. submit, and status <id> done, which runs it, print submit.schema.json instead.

item.description: The item after the move, exactly as its file holds it.

warnings.description: Only for start, where it's always present: one message for each criterion check that already passed at start, before the work is done (DESIGN.md §2.4). The start still went ahead. item.started.checks has every check's result.
